items.title: China's Xi keeps Iranian president at arm's length weeks ahead of Trump summit
items.description: China's Xi gave Iran's Pezeshkian a brief, low-profile audience at the SCO summit, as Beijing seeks to avoid appearing close to Tehran ahead of a high-stakes summit with Trump.

items.title: Oil major BP completes search for chair after boardroom upheaval
items.description: BP on Wednesday formally appointed Ian Tyler as chair after a surprise dismissal of former chairman Albert Manifold sparked boardroom turmoil.

items.title: Trump says U.S. is not forcing Iran to negotiate after fresh round of strikes
items.description: U.S. forces completed another wave of strikes against Iran on Tuesday stateside, hitting multiple Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps sites across the country.

items.title: Australia posts second-quarter growth of 2.1%, beating expectations
items.description: The GDP print will allow the Reserve Bank of Australia room to go ahead with its policy tightening as it seeks to curb inflation.

items.title: Japanese green tea giant Ito En surges 8%, defying a broad market sell-off
items.description: Ito En shares surged, bucking a broader sell-off in Japanese stocks following its fiscal first-quarter results.

items.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
items.description: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.

items.title: China dissented from G20 statement opposing 'cheap exports' flooding market, Bessent says
items.description: Bessent is leading the Trump administration's plan to choke off Iran's economy by threatening its business partners with secondary sanctions.

items.title: Palo Alto CEO says $1 trillion of cybersecurity infrastructure isn’t ready for AI
items.description: Palo Alto CEO Nikesh Arora said AI is forcing companies to modernize roughly $1 trillion of aging cybersecurity infrastructure that isn’t equipped for attacks.

items.title: House adopts measure condemning socialism ahead of November election
items.description: Republicans also inserted a call to pass the highly controversial voter-ID bill known as the SAVE America Act into the socialism resolution.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks beats quarterly estimates on AI demand, continues acquisition spree
items.description: Palo Alto Networks' stock has nearly doubled this year as AI boosts demand for security detection and response tools

items.title: Stan Kroenke agrees to buy MLB's Angels, valuing team and regional network at $4 billion
items.description: Kroenke Sports and Entertainment was valued at more than $26 billion in CNBC's most recent list of the world's most valuable sports empires.

items.title: Dell surges 9% after lifting fiscal 2027 forecast on AI server strength
items.description: Dell sees AI server revenue tripling in fiscal 2027. Six months ago, it was looking for the number to double.

items.title: 10-year yield hits highest since January 2025 as higher oil prices stoke inflation worries
items.description: Treasury yields increased on Tuesday as investors monitored a reignition of tensions in the Middle East.

items.title: U.S. House votes to avoid government shutdown amid GOP hard-liner resistance
items.description: The U.S. House on Tuesday voted in favor of a short-term spending measure that would avoid a government shutdown until after November's midterm election.

items.title: GoPro joins AI bonanza with pivot into data centers as shares skyrocket 40%
items.description: Action camera maker GoPro is merging with private photonics company Starman Optical and joining the AI wave.

items.title: OpenAI says Astra AI model is its first that crosses 'Critical' cybersecurity capability
items.description: OpenAI said it will make Astra available "soon," but access to its cybersecurity capabilities will be limited.

items.title: Pa. Gov. Shapiro says too many data center developers 'don't care about our communities'
items.description: A Gallup survey released in May found that "seven in 10 Americans oppose constructing data centers for artificial intelligence in their local area."

items.description: A closely followed measure of artificial intelligence token prices touched fresh lows.

items.title: Prediction market traders think job creation rebounded in August
items.description: Traders see 50-50 odds that the U.S. economy added more than 50,000 jobs last month.
